# Website Vikreta
> Website Vikreta is an AI-first web and automation studio. The team is based in Pune, India and works with clients worldwide, with coverage during US hours. We build websites, apps, and AI automation systems for businesses in the US, UK and other Western markets.

## AI Automations

- [Workflow Automation](https://www.websitevikreta.com/services/ai-automations/workflow-automation): Connect CRMs, documents and inboxes so routine work runs without hand-offs.
  - [CRM automation](https://www.websitevikreta.com/services/ai-automations/workflow-automation/crm-automation): Leads, notes and next steps land in your CRM on their own.
  - [Document data extraction](https://www.websitevikreta.com/services/ai-automations/workflow-automation/document-data-extraction): Reads invoices, forms and PDFs and sends clean data where it belongs.
  - [AI teammates](https://www.websitevikreta.com/services/ai-automations/workflow-automation/ai-teammates): Your own AI assistants living in your team chat.
- [AI Voice Agents](https://www.websitevikreta.com/services/ai-automations/ai-voice-agents): AI phone agents that answer calls, qualify leads and book appointments.
  - [AI receptionist](https://www.websitevikreta.com/services/ai-automations/ai-voice-agents/ai-receptionist): Answers every call, handles questions and books the job.
  - [Outbound lead qualification](https://www.websitevikreta.com/services/ai-automations/ai-voice-agents/outbound-lead-qualification): Calls new leads within minutes and books the good ones.
- [WhatsApp Automation](https://www.websitevikreta.com/services/ai-automations/whatsapp-automation): Lead follow-up, reminders and support on WhatsApp.
  - [WhatsApp lead follow-up](https://www.websitevikreta.com/services/ai-automations/whatsapp-automation/whatsapp-lead-follow-up)
  - [Appointment reminders](https://www.websitevikreta.com/services/ai-automations/whatsapp-automation/appointment-reminders)
- [HR Automation](https://www.websitevikreta.com/services/ai-automations/hr-automation): Offer letters, onboarding, screening and contracts.
  - [Offer letter automation](https://www.websitevikreta.com/services/ai-automations/hr-automation/offer-letter-automation)
  - [Employee onboarding automation](https://www.websitevikreta.com/services/ai-automations/hr-automation/employee-onboarding-automation)
- [AI UGC Ads](https://www.websitevikreta.com/services/ai-automations/ai-ugc-ads): UGC-style video ads and spokesperson videos from product images.
  - [AI UGC video ads](https://www.websitevikreta.com/services/ai-automations/ai-ugc-ads/ai-ugc-video-ads): Creator-style video ads, made fast and labeled as AI.
  - [AI spokesperson videos](https://www.websitevikreta.com/services/ai-automations/ai-ugc-ads/ai-spokesperson-videos): One AI face for your explainers, launches and updates.
- [Content Automation](https://www.websitevikreta.com/services/ai-automations/content-automation): SEO blog posts, social content and repurposing.
  - [SEO blog content](https://www.websitevikreta.com/services/ai-automations/content-automation/seo-blog-content): Researched blog posts that answer real search questions.
  - [Social media content](https://www.websitevikreta.com/services/ai-automations/content-automation/social-media-content): Social posts drafted and scheduled by message.
- [Proposal Automation](https://www.websitevikreta.com/services/ai-automations/proposal-automation): Proposals, RFP responses and scopes of work.
  - [Proposal generation](https://www.websitevikreta.com/services/ai-automations/proposal-automation/proposal-generation)
  - [RFP response automation](https://www.websitevikreta.com/services/ai-automations/proposal-automation/rfp-response-automation)
- [Finance Automation](https://www.websitevikreta.com/services/ai-automations/finance-automation): Invoices, payment reminders, expense extraction and reports.
  - [Invoice automation](https://www.websitevikreta.com/services/ai-automations/finance-automation/invoice-automation): Job done, invoice sent, with no retyping.
  - [Payment reminder automation](https://www.websitevikreta.com/services/ai-automations/finance-automation/payment-reminder-automation): Polite nudges for late invoices until they are paid.

## AI automation FAQ topics

Answered on https://www.websitevikreta.com/services/ai-automations: cost, build time, supported tools, whether you need a tech team, data safety, AI talking to customers, what happens if an automation breaks, and who owns the automations.

## About

Website Vikreta designs and builds fast websites and AI automation for small and mid-sized businesses. The team is in Pune, India. Clients are in the US, UK and elsewhere, and the team covers US working hours.

We run our own company on these automations. Our AI agents are named Meher (HR), Ira (content and UGC) and Arjun (sales and finance).
